{{Top|leg|title=''Dor'bulla''-class warship}}
The '''''Dor'bulla''-class warship''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] class manufactured by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was one the rarest warships used by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. This ship was produced on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], in the sprawling facilities of the [[Guarja Shipyards]] to the south of [[Bilbousa/Legends|Bilbousa]].
